focus.en: Organic Discovery, Visual Merchandising & WhatsApp Enquiry Support
focus.bm: Penemuan Organik, Visual Promosi & Sokongan Pertanyaan WhatsApp

en: Created promotional posters and natural Bahasa Malaysia copywriting for durian, seasonal produce, and daily stock updates (1–3 creatives per active day).
Published listings across Facebook Marketplace (documented since 2021) and targeted Kemaman community Facebook Groups.
Built a Google Site and maintained Google Business Profile / Google Search local map visibility.
Handled incoming WhatsApp customer enquiries covering stock availability, pricing, pickup, and delivery coordination.
bm: Menghasilkan poster promosi dan penulisan kapsyen Bahasa Melayu semula jadi untuk jualan durian, buah bermusim dan kemas kini stok harian (1–3 kreatif setiap hari aktif).
Menerbitkan senarai produk di Facebook Marketplace (direkodkan sejak 2021) serta kumpulan komuniti Facebook sekitar Kemaman.
Membina laman Google Sites dan menguruskan keterlihatan carian tempatan melalui Google Business Profile serta Google Search.
Mengendalikan pertanyaan pelanggan di WhatsApp berkaitan stok semasa, harga, pengambilan sendiri (pickup) dan penyelarasan penghantaran.

whyItMatters.en: Handling years of real WhatsApp stock enquiries revealed how slow replies lose walk-in and delivery sales — directly inspiring the sub-10s SLA routing in PRJ-01 and WhatsApp-to-counter receipt attribution in PRJ-04.
whyItMatters.bm: Pengalaman mengendalikan pertanyaan stok WhatsApp selama bertahun-tahun membuktikan balasan perlahan menyebabkan jualan terlepas — menjadi asas langsung kepada penghalaan SLA bawah-10 saat dalam PRJ-01 dan atribusi resit kaunter WhatsApp dalam PRJ-04.

evidenceBoundary.en: Establishes multi-year publishing consistency, local offer framing, and verified Google Business Profile search presence.
evidenceBoundary.bm: Membuktikan konsistensi penerbitan berbilang tahun, penyusunan tawaran tempatan, dan kehadiran carian sah di Google Business Profile.

focus.en: Request-Based Menu Visuals, Product Copywriting & Community Distribution
focus.bm: Poster Promosi Menu, Penulisan Kapsyen Produk & Hebahan Komuniti

en: Produced 2–3 promotional posters per client request highlighting signature drinks and desserts (e.g., Koleksi Premium PedalHaus).
Wrote concise Bahasa Malaysia captions with product-led hooks and clear dine-in / tapau / pickup calls to action.
Distributed approved promotional creatives across Kemaman Facebook community groups and archived POS summary observations.
bm: Menghasilkan 2–3 poster promosi bagi setiap permintaan klien untuk menu minuman dan pencuci mulut utama (cth. Koleksi Premium PedalHaus).
Menulis kapsyen Bahasa Melayu padat dengan tarikan berfokuskan produk serta seruan tindakan jelas (Dine-in / Tapau / Pickup).
Mengedarkan bahan promosi yang diluluskan ke kumpulan komuniti Facebook Kemaman serta menyimpan rekod pemerhatian ringkasan jualan POS.

whyItMatters.en: Tracking POS net sales after promo pushes reinforced why creative hooks must align with profitable menu items and real cash register totals — the exact unit-economics principle behind PRJ-02 and PRJ-05.
whyItMatters.bm: Menjejaki jualan bersih POS selepas hebahan promosi mengukuhkan prinsip bahawa tarikan kreatif mesti selari dengan item bermargin sihat dan jumlah tunai sebenar di kaunter — prinsip ekonomi unit yang mendasari PRJ-02 dan PRJ-05.

evidenceBoundary.en: POS net sales increase observed following promotional activity is documented transparently as an operational observation, without claiming isolated paid-ad attribution.
evidenceBoundary.bm: Peningkatan jualan bersih POS selepas aktiviti promosi direkodkan secara telus sebagai pemerhatian operasi tanpa tuntutan atribusi iklan berbayar yang berlebihan.

focus.en: Dual-Audience Community Marketing (Parent Enquiries & PSV Driver Recruitment)
focus.bm: Pemasaran Komuniti Dua Sasaran (Pertanyaan Ibu Bapa & Pengambilan Pemandu PSV)

en: Crafted parent-facing route announcements covering SK Binjai, SMK Binjai, SK Sri Jaya, and PASTI routes for the 2024/25 school session.
Wrote structured recruitment copy in Feb 2025 for part-time school van drivers, addressing PSV licensing support, shift schedules, and WhatsApp application steps.
bm: Menyediakan hebahan laluan van sekolah khusus untuk ibu bapa merangkumi SK Binjai, SMK Binjai, SK Sri Jaya dan PASTI bagi sesi persekolahan 2024/25.
Menulis iklan pengambilan pemandu van separuh masa pada Feb 2025 secara terperinci merangkumi bantuan Lesen PSV, jadual waktu kerja dan langkah permohonan WhatsApp.

whyItMatters.en: Separating parent trust messaging from driver qualification criteria mirrors audience segmentation and structured lead-intake filtering in PRJ-01 and PRJ-03.
whyItMatters.bm: Pengasingan mesej kepercayaan ibu bapa daripada syarat kelayakan pemandu mencerminkan segmentasi audiens dan penapisan kemasukan prospek berstruktur dalam PRJ-01 serta PRJ-03.

evidenceBoundary.en: Demonstrates versatility across retail, F&B, local services, and recruitment communication.
evidenceBoundary.bm: Menunjukkan keupayaan menyesuaikan mesej merentasi peruncitan, F&B, perkhidmatan komuniti dan komunikasi pengambilan pekerja.
